-- Anti-Tamper & Debug Protection
local function checkIntegrity()
    local mt = getmetatable(getfenv())
    if mt and (mt.__index or mt.__newindex) then
        error('Tampering detected!', 0)
    end
end
pcall(checkIntegrity)

local function antiDebug()
    if debug and debug.getinfo then
        local info = debug.getinfo(2)
        if info and info.what == 'C' then
            error('Debugger detected!', 0)
        end
    end
end
pcall(antiDebug)
